benchmark: evals/followups.json (4 multi-turn questions against Too Good to Be True)

openai/gpt-oss-120b.strengths: Direct, engaging persona adherence, 100% answer correctness on grounded questions, clean markdown citations.
openai/gpt-oss-120b.weaknesses: Higher parameter footprint; occasional unfaithful flag when citing verbatim Hindi dialog from the page.

qwen/qwen3.8-27b.strengths: Faster median latency (2.24s), strictly refuses when retrieval misses the source page (faithful).
qwen/qwen3.8-27b.weaknesses: Daily 200k token quota on Groq free tier; tends to emit long internal reasoning monologues into conversational chat.

recommendation.rationale: Superior conversational tone for the Enthusiastic Librarian persona, higher answer correctness (100% vs 75%), and does not hit the 200k daily TPD quota limit on Groq.
recommendation.judge_rationale: Compact 7B model, zero rate limit contention with generation model, fast and reliable for JSON verdict scoring.
